title: OsuMappingBrief
description: Input contract schema for osu! mapping workflow in MultiAI Classroom.

mode.description: The execution mode for the mapping workflow.

ruleset.description: Target game mode ruleset. MVP strictly supports standard osu! (Mode 0).

audio_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the song audio file.

source_beatmap_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to existing source .osu file for modify/validate mode.

bpm.description: Song tempo in Beats Per Minute. Must be strictly positive.

offset_ms.description: Millisecond offset of the first downbeat in the audio track.

references.description: Array of file paths to reference .osu beatmaps used for similarity comparison.

mapper_reference.description: Optional mapper profile or aggregate reference metadata.

output_root.description: Root path where the isolated run directory will be created.

preserve_source.description: Ensure original source files are strictly treated as read-only.

overwrite.description: Whether existing artifacts in run directory may be overwritten.

require_full_song_coverage.description: Enforce minimum 95% mapping coverage across active audio duration.

require_originality_resolution.description: Require anti-plagiarism originality check against references.
